title: quota-garden-standup-notes-2026-12-28
content:
Date: 2026-12-28
Time: 09:30 PT (15m) — quick cross-team sync
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Maya, Jonah, Selina (SRE), Alex (Serving Runtime) — pinged: ops-oncall
Goal: capture immediate follow-ups from routing/quotas/auth signals this week and surface lightweight rollout plan for quota throttle exemptions.

1) Quick status snapshot
- Signal summary: quota controller emitted elevated soft-throttle events for customer tier 'dedicated-small' on 12/26 and 12/27 during the late-afternoon burst window. Root cause suspected to be a combination of a routing change (route partitioning) and new batching behavior in runtime v1.13.
- Impact: ~18 customers experienced sporadic 429s for 4–12 minutes; latency for routed requests spiked P95 -> 420ms (baseline 220ms). No data exfiltration, auth unaffected at token-level.
- Current mitigation: temporary increase of per-route burst allowance (+25%) and fallback to older routing policy for high-priority orgs. These mitigations deployed 12/27 03:10 PT and held.

2) Root-cause analysis (work-in-progress)
- Observed sequence: routing allocator started returning fewer active endpoints for region-us-west-2 for routes with 'session_affinity'. This increased per-node load and triggered quota soft-throttles.
- Two contributing changes:
  a) PLT-#4390: route affinity optimization rolled as canary on 12/25 (Ethan). Canary worked but interaction with batch-windowing in runtime v1.13 (PR #1189) exposed cache eviction pattern.
  b) Runtime v1.13 altered batch coalescing thresholds; longer-lived streams held KV cache longer which increased tail latency under uneven routing.
- Evidence: allocation logs (allocator-logs-12-26.json), KV-cache-metrics (KVCacheEvict spikes at 12/26 16:02 PT).

3) Short-term plan (next 72h)
- Revert route-affinity tweak for canary subsets affecting us-west-2 (owner: Ethan) — target: 2026-12-29 02:00 PT.
- Patch quota-controller to add a 2-minute adaptive backoff before emitting soft-throttle alerts for ephemeral spikes (owner: Jonah) — prototype PR by 12/29 EOD.
- Add temporary compensating rule: exempt 'dedicated-small' orgs with active SLA flag from soft-throttle for 24 hours while we observe (owner: Maya) — change deployed 12/27, confirm metrics 12/29 morning.

4) Medium-term work (sprint planning items)
- Create a compact test harness to reproduce asymmetric routing load + batch-coalescing; include reproducer for KV cache eviction (owner: Alex, ticket JIRA-PLT-4462).
- Update rollout checklist: add a dependency matrix step that checks runtime batch thresholds vs routing affinity flags before canary promotion. (owner: Priya)
- Quota tuning experiment: run A/B on bucketing strategy (fixed vs dynamic) for per-route quotas across three traffic patterns; measure cost per 1M tokens and client error rate.

5) Auth note (brief)
- Logged one unrelated auth token renewal failure during the window (error 401 on idp-redwood-1). Root cause was transient 503 from IdP; no correlated quota events. SRE performed a token refresh spike mitigation; follow-up with security team if frequency increases. (owner: Selina)

6) Ops/Runbook changes
- Add a quick diagnostic checklist to the control plane runbook:
  - Check allocator active-endpoints per-route (metric name: allocator.endpoints.active)
  - Check KV cache eviction rate (runtime.kvcache.evictions)
  - If soft-throttle count > 5 within 10m, temporarily increase per-route burst and notify #pltfm-oncall
- Owner for runbook updates: Jonah — PR to docs by 12/30.

7) Action items (owner — due)
- Ethan: revert route-affinity tweak for affected canary set (due 2026-12-29 02:00 PT)
- Jonah: quota-controller adaptive backoff prototype + PR (due 2026-12-29 23:59 PT)
- Maya: confirm temporary exemption metrics and compile impact summary (due 2026-12-29 10:00 PT)
- Alex: start reproducer harness and drop initial logs in /shared/qa/quota-reproducer (due 2027-01-05)
- Priya: add rollout dependency matrix to the promotion checklist (due 2027-01-03)
- Selina: monitor IdP token errors and escalate to security if >3 occurrences/day (ongoing)

8) Parking lot / lower priority
- Investigate finer-grained quota buckets by endpoint type (embedding vs generation) — research spike in cost modeling.
- Consider a lightweight telemetry signal that flags 'routing-skew' per-region to trigger autoscaling more aggressively.

9) Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Could we leverage prefix-KV caching to reduce pressure during session-heavy workloads? Worth a spike.
- Need to coordinate with Dedicated team before changing quota exemptions in prod; risk=medium.

10) Next sync
- Quick follow-up async update in #pltfm-channel by 12/29 12:00 PT. Next standing slot: brief sync 2026-12-31 09:30 PT if any outstanding regressions.

Links & references:
- Canary change: github.com/redwood-inference/pltfm/commit/ab34c2 (PLT-4390)
- Runtime batch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1189
- Allocator logs snapshot: s3://redwood-logs/allocator/2026-12-26/summary.log

End of notes.

-- Priya (scribbles)
